purpose: Machine-readable record of what the committed run-level tables leave out and why, so that per-record statistics use the same population.

voided_attempts.reason: infrastructure failure (checkpoint loading) during the first attempt; the run was trained again under the same id
voided_attempts.per_record_exports: the part-B per_record files on Hugging Face hold the rows of both attempts under this run_id

voided_attempts.reason: infrastructure failure (checkpoint loading) during the first attempt; the run was trained again under the same id
voided_attempts.per_record_exports: the part-B per_record files on Hugging Face hold the rows of both attempts under this run_id

duplicate_classical_rows.scope: Darcy and Poisson V4-D references of the 128^2 slices, computed independently on both accounts with identical means and selected settings

run_level_export_of_part_B.reason: two voided-attempt rows of the export carry a machine path; runs_long.part-B.csv in this directory is the run-level table of part B

rule: A per-record aggregate of a voided run id must keep the rows of the repeated attempt only; the per-view mean of the kept rows equals the mean column of runs_long.part-B.csv.
